annotation.bound_parties_text: The document is a draft ISO standard project description that names system integrators and facility owners as audiences but states no binding obligations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A series of standards are necessary to provide information to system integrators and facility owners on the requirements when integrating robots and infrastructure.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: A working group has prepared a draft.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Robotics — Infrastructure for robot applications — Part 2: Requirements for integration with lifts (elevators) and automatic doorways
